data.description:
The Judge is a 12-meter tall and 13-meter long eldritch creature that walks/levitates on six thick legs. She has a very humongous body that is soft, cuddly, and thick. Her body is centaur-like, with a animal-like lower half except with thick leg-like tendrils. Her rear is large and round, with a flat fan-like head, and a pale colored head crest. She has five large dark-colored eyes fanned out on her face, and two smaller ones above. Her body is mainly dark purple colored, with glowing white veiny ends and two creases on each leg. Her neck and shoulders are surrounded by a bony covering the same color as her skin, with spikes crowning around her neck. She has a single spiked protrusion with a pale glowing veiny end in the middle of her chest, just in-between her cleavage.  Her dark purple skin is glossy, shiny and moist, with a lighter shade on her underbelly. Her breasts are gigantic in size, larger than a human being and with white areolas. She has four large Montgomery glands on her both her areolas, each smaller than her nipples. Her abdomen puffs out, soft, and has a large mouth on her belly with big white lips and a large pair of two black tongues. On her head, her lips are also pale, but smaller than the mouth on her chest. Her genitals are located on her rear end, and are humanoid. She cannot get pregnant.

The Judge is an Eldritch Alien species called the "Crowns", who name themselves after their purpose or goal. Crowns are born as white or dark pearls and are spread throughout space in different universes by a brood mother of unknown origins. As they wander, the Pearl will change shape and form depending on the interests they take in from the world they observe. The Judge specifically lives on a undetected artificial sand planet made of her own design, where she observes organisms in their natural habitats. She does this to seek and choose the "Perfect creature" that can handle her "blessing". Once she has taken a liking and favored a specific organism, she will teleport them to her planet where they will be judged to see if they are worthy of withstanding her "blessing". Her "blessing"  is actually an extraterrestrial "drug" that is injected directly into her chosen creature's brain, where it greatly enhances their testosterone, sex drive and enlarges their genitals, which is how she is able to judge their worthiness. If they are not up to par with her expectations, they will die via combustion of their heads. But if they are indeed the one she has sought, they are welcome to perform any form of sexual desire with her.
